personality: 2 Material You / Expressive LIGHT or DARK (Utility Variant)
personality_one_liner: A calm, professional, and privacy-focused business utility built around expressive but structured tonal surfaces.

spacing.rule: Generous tonal spacing. Elements should group visually via spacing rather than harsh borders. Tap targets minimum 44x44pt.

do's: Use on sticky Detail Screen headers when scrolling over the chat archive.
Use on the floating action button (FAB) with a brandTertiary base.
Use over the premium Pro Upgrade hero background.
dont's: Do not use on individual list rows or basic input forms.
Do not over-blur; ensure >70% opacity tint for underlying layers.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Establish trust and explain the core value: protecting customer history and instantly recalling context.
screens.layout: Full-bleed imagery at the top (with absolute top-to-bottom three-stop linear gradient scrim to ensure text readability). Content restricted to the bottom 40% of the screen. Display title (weight 500) and muted subtitle. A sticky primary CTA ('Get Started') anchored at the safe-area bottom.

screens.name: Customer List (Home)
screens.purpose: Primary command center to quickly find, filter, and act on customer chats.

states.empty: Illustration of calm abstract shapes + 'No customers yet. Share a chat from WhatsApp to begin' + Primary CTA to 'Import'
states.error: Readable text 'Failed to load archive' + Retry button

screens.layout: Header with 'Customers' and a Search input. Immediately below, a horizontal scrollable row of filter chips (All, Follow-ups, Recent) using 'brandTertiary' for active states. The main body is a FlatList of Customer Cards. FAB placed at bottom-right for manual add/import.

screens.name: Customer Detail
screens.purpose: View the archived WhatsApp conversation, add private notes/tags, and set follow-ups.

states.empty: Empty state reading 'No messages archived yet' if customer is created manually without import.

screens.layout: Collapsing glass header showing the Avatar and Customer Name. Two-tab segmented control: 'Archive' and 'Notes'. Archive tab displays a read-only list of message bubbles (Left/Customer in 'surfaceSecondary', Right/Business in 'brandTertiary'). Notes tab shows a structured view with a text area, tag chip group, and 'Set Follow-up' sticky button.

screens.name: Pro Upgrade & Rescue Pack
screens.purpose: Upsell the pro tier while offering peace of mind via the Rescue Pack export.
screens.layout: Cinematic header using the 'premium dark textured' image with a dark gradient scrim, layered with a glassmorphism card detailing the Pro features. The 'Rescue Pack' section should feel highly secure and solid (surfaceSecondary card with a clear 'brandPrimary' export button).

components.customer_list_card: flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'md', padding: 'lg'. Avatar (36-40pt, fallback to initials if no logo). Center column (flex: 1) contains Name ('lg', weight 500) and Last Activity ('sm', 'muted'). Trailing column contains follow-up star icon or unread message badge (pill shape, 'brandTertiary'). Use 'surfaceSecondary' with 'md' radius for the card. No shadow.
components.chip_row: flexDirection: 'row', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 'sm'. Chips use 'surfaceTertiary' background, 'pill' radius, and 'sm' padding horizontal. Active chips switch to 'brandTertiary'.
components.bottom_nav: Material 3 inspired tall bar (~80pt). Background 'surface'. Active tab uses a pill-shaped indicator ('brandTertiary') behind the filled active icon. Inactive tabs use outlined icons.
components.message_bubble: Radius 'lg'. Incoming (Customer) aligned left, 'surfaceSecondary' bg. Outgoing (Business) aligned right, 'brandTertiary' bg. Padding 'md'. Maximum width 80%.
components.fab: Absolute positioned bottom-right above safe area. 56x56pt, 'lg' radius (squircle/rounded rect). Background 'brandPrimary', icon 'onBrandPrimary'.

empty_state_abstract.alt: Calm abstract botanical shapes olive green

pro_hero_dark.alt: Abstract premium dark textured background water droplets

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Material You (Utility Variant) personality. The app should feel highly professional, calm, and privacy-focused—never playful or childish.
Zero tolerance for blue, indigo, purple, or neon accents. Use the provided deep sage and slate color tokens.
No emojis allowed anywhere in the system UI.

Ensure the Onboarding screens and Pro Upgrade screens use the specified background images layered with the mandatory 3-stop vertical gradient scrim (transparent -> 20% surfaceInverse -> 70% surfaceInverse) to guarantee text readability.
Implement the Customer List as a stacked list of surfaceSecondary cards (no shadows). Follow the component specs closely for the layout (Avatar -> Name/Activity -> Trailing Status).
For the Customer Detail screen, build a segmented control or tab interface separating the Chat Archive (message bubbles) from the Notes/Tags view.
Always use the 'Plus Jakarta Sans' (Heading) and 'Geist' (Body) font pairings. Cap all font weights at 500.
Wire haptics directly on primary actions like FAB, chip toggles, and Rescue Pack exports as specified.
